name: Kidde C3010 carbon monoxide alarm
summary: A sealed-battery carbon monoxide alarm in the C3010 family. Canadian certification and equivalence to C3010-CA have not been established for this listing.
description: A carbon monoxide alarm must match the certification and installation requirements of the place where it will be used. The US C3010 data sheet documents part 21010045, a sealed battery and an electrochemical sensor. These details describe the US product family; they do not establish C3010-CA equivalence or suitability for installation in a Canadian home.
